objects.name: notification_batch_items_batch
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX notification_batch_items_batch ON notification_batch_items(batch_id)

objects.name: notification_events_created
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX notification_events_created ON notification_events(created_at)

objects.name: outbox_ready
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX outbox_ready ON outbox(state,next_attempt)

objects.name: submissions_message
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX submissions_message ON submissions(bot_id,json_extract(receipt,'$.messageId'))

objects.name: submissions_status
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX submissions_status ON submissions(json_extract(receipt,'$.status'))

objects.name: approval_attribution
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE approval_attribution(approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,bot_id TEXT NOT NULL,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),decision TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: bot_presentation
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE bot_presentation(bot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner_id TEXT,shared INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,avatar TEXT)

objects.name: card_state
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE card_state(user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),bot_id TEXT NOT NULL,message_id TEXT NOT NULL,card_id TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(user_id,bot_id,message_id,card_id))

objects.name: delivered
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE delivered(outbox_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES outbox(id),endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(outbox_id,endpoint))

objects.name: drafts
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE drafts(user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),bot_id TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(user_id,bot_id))

objects.name: metadata
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE metadata(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: native_codes
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE native_codes(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),state TEXT NOT NULL,challenge TEXT NOT NULL,expires INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: native_devices
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE native_devices(device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),session_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES native_sessions(hash) ON DELETE CASCADE,token TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(token,environment))

objects.name: native_flows
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE native_flows(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,state TEXT NOT NULL,challenge TEXT NOT NULL,nonce TEXT NOT NULL,expires INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: native_sessions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE native_sessions(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),expires INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: notification_batch_items
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE notification_batch_items(outbox_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES outbox(id),batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_batches(id))

objects.name: notification_batches
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE notification_batches(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),payload TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: notification_events
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE notification_events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: notification_ingestion
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE notification_ingestion(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,event_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

objects.name: outbox
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE outbox(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,event_id TEXT NOT NULL,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),payload TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,next_attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT,UNIQUE(event_id,user_id))

objects.name: participants
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE participants(run_id TEXT NOT NULL,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),PRIMARY KEY(run_id,user_id))

objects.name: preferences
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE preferences(user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id),value TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: read_positions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE read_positions(user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),bot_id TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(user_id,bot_id))

objects.name: routine_recipients
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE routine_recipients(routine_id TEXT NOT NULL,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),PRIMARY KEY(routine_id,user_id))

objects.name: routine_trials
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE routine_trials(request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),routine_id TEXT NOT NULL,bot_id TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'uncertain')

objects.name: saved_items
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE saved_items(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),pointer_key TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(user_id,pointer_key))

objects.name: session_confirmations
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE session_confirmations(session_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES sessions(hash) ON DELETE CASCADE,confirmed_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: sessions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE sessions(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),csrf TEXT NOT NULL,expires INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: submissions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE submissions(request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,bot_id TEXT NOT NULL,sender_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),payload TEXT NOT NULL,receipt TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: subscriptions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE subscriptions(endpoint TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),value TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: today_seen
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE today_seen(user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id),seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,event_frontier INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

objects.name: users
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE users(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,picture TEXT)
